top_developments.title: Ontario Budget 2026 — $210B Ten-Year Capital Plan
top_developments.summary: Finance Minister tabled Budget 2026 on March 26 with $37B for 2026-27, $64B over 10 years for health infrastructure (50 hospital projects, 3,000 beds), $31B for highways, Ring of Fire road targeted June 2026.
top_developments.source_description: Ontario Ministry of Finance

top_developments.title: U.S. Section 232 Tariff Restructuring — 50% Duties
top_developments.summary: U.S. restructured Section 232 tariffs effective April 6 with 50% duties on steel and aluminum imports. Motor vehicle surtax extended. Canada weighing retaliatory measures.
top_developments.source_description: Department of Finance Canada

top_developments.title: Build Communities Strong Fund — $51B
top_developments.summary: Federal government launched $51B Build Communities Strong Fund on April 7 for municipal infrastructure including transit, water, broadband, and community facilities.
top_developments.source_description: Infrastructure Canada

top_developments.title: Critical Minerals Alliance Round 2 — $12.1B
top_developments.summary: Canada announced Round 2 of the Critical Minerals Alliance unlocking $12.1B in investment. Covers 659 well licences in March (+48% YoY).
top_developments.source_description: Natural Resources Canada

top_developments.title: Canadian Sovereign AI Compute Strategy — $1.7B+
top_developments.summary: Federal government announced Sovereign AI Compute Strategy with $700M in public investment plus $1B+ private sector commitments for AI infrastructure and data centres.
top_developments.source_description: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada

top_developments.title: Quebec Budget 2026-27 — $167B Infrastructure Plan
top_developments.summary: Quebec tabled its 2026-27 budget with a $167B infrastructure plan covering hospitals, transit, and housing across the province.
top_developments.source_description: Quebec Ministry of Finance

top_developments.title: Nova Scotia Powering the Economy Act
